But wait, the blocks are 4 rows tall and the bar is only 2 rows tall. So the blocks extend below the bar. Maybe the blocks can slide under the notch?
Actually, looking at the image, the blocks are sitting on top of the bar. The notch is a gap in the bar. If the blocks are 4 rows tall and the bar is 2 rows tall, the blocks extend 2 rows below the bar. The notch is only in the bar (2 rows), so the space below the notch is still solid (or empty?).
Let me try moving the blocks LEFT and see what happens. I'll move them until they reach the notch.
